12.t: Working with data: joint injuries in sport
q: Which injury was most common in football?
How many joint injuries were there in basketball?
Suggest why basketball has many finger sprains but swimming has none.
Basketball players catch a hard ball that can bend fingers; swimming has no contact or impact.
The football club has 60 members and the swimming club 20. Explain why this matters when comparing.
Raw totals are unfair: work out injuries per member (football 23 / 60 = 0.38; swimming 2 / 20 = 0.1). Football is still riskier, but by less than the totals suggest.
